# `parameter-became-optional`

Parameter became optional

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `parameter-became-optional` (all locations), `query-parameter-became-optional`, `header-parameter-became-optional`, `cookie-parameter-became-optional`. Path parameters use `parameter-became-optional`. |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Parameters ([RULES.md section 4](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A required parameter is now optional.

## Why this default

Clients that send it keep working.

## Example

From test case [`parameter-became-optional`](../../test/cases/parameter-became-optional/): Required → optional.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
        - name: limit
          in: query
-         required: true
+         required: false
          schema:
            type: string
```

Findings:

- `query-parameter-became-optional` · info · GET /pets

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.


## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file, for the generic ID or any variant ID above (the more specific ID wins). See [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  parameter-became-optional: info
```
